title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
河南鄉試錄序
皇上改元之明年適天下貢士
之期河南牧伯憲臣白於
巡按監察御史鄭〔陽〕會舉
文學掾之可以典司文衡
者咨具書幣遣使者四出
聘之既至〔暘〕與考舊章洛
===
艹實精慮害試綱條宏密
前此入試之士數惡猥多
選定比昔務期約損則以
屬之提學副使宋〔禮〕精校
閱嚴去取無私之至神明
可質則以屬之〔恂〕及學正
秦〔鎰〕教諭李〔翰〕郭〔基〕倪〔域〕
punctuated:
河南鄉試錄序

皇上改元之明年，適天下貢士之期。河南牧伯憲臣白於巡按監察御史鄭〔陽〕，會舉文學掾之可以典司文衡者，咨具書幣，遣使者四出聘之。既至，〔暘〕與考舊章，洛艹實精慮害試綱條宏密。前此入試之士數惡猥多，選定比昔務期約損，則以屬之提學副使宋〔禮〕。精校閱，嚴去取，無私之至，神明可質，則以屬之〔恂〕及學正秦〔鎰〕、教諭李〔翰〕、郭〔基〕、倪〔域〕、
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Henan Provincial Examination

In the year following His Majesty’s change of reign title, the time arrived for the empire to present scholars as tribute. Henan’s regional administrators and judicial officials reported to the Regional Inspector, Investigating Censor Zheng Yang 鄭陽. Together they nominated educational officials qualified to take charge of evaluating literary merit, arranged letters and gifts, and dispatched envoys in all directions to invite them. Once they had arrived, Yang 〔暘〕[?—written 陽 above] joined in examining the established regulations. [The following wording is garbled: 洛艹實精慮害試.] The examination’s rules and provisions were comprehensive and meticulous [?]. Previously, the numbers of candidates entering the examination had been excessively large [?]. Responsibility for selecting them, with the express aim of reducing their numbers compared with earlier examinations, was entrusted to Song Li 宋禮, Vice Commissioner for Education. Responsibility for scrutinizing the papers carefully and applying rigorous standards of acceptance and rejection, with an impartiality so complete that the spirits themselves could attest to it, was entrusted to Xun 〔恂〕, together with Qin Yi 秦鎰, an Instructor, and Li Han 李翰, Guo Ji 郭基, and Ni Yu 倪域, Educational Instructors, …

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
訓導朱〔祖元〕逯〔墳〕王〔朝臣〕張〔輅〕
汪〔穎〕充奉百費訓飭羣司
則以屬之左布政使張〔子麟〕
右布政使南〔鏜〕禁私戢僞
防過姦非則以屬之按察
使朱〔恩〕僉事仲〔本〕其餘執
事悉由才選此皆爲乎其
===
內者耳爲乎其外則以屬
之左參政車〔璽〕右參政劉
約左參議馬〔駉〕右參議田
彭副使閻〔璽〕楊〔壽〕鄭〔端〕僉
事席〔書〕薛〔英〕韓〔鼐〕於時鎮
守太監廖〔堂〕清戎監察御
史馬〔騤〕實共參懷務期作
punctuated: 訓導朱〔祖元〕、逯〔墳〕、王〔朝臣〕、張〔輅〕、汪〔穎〕。充奉百費，訓飭羣司，則以屬之左布政使張〔子麟〕、右布政使南〔鏜〕。禁私戢僞，防過姦非，則以屬之按察使朱〔恩〕、僉事仲〔本〕。其餘執事，悉由才選。此皆爲乎其內者耳。爲乎其外，則以屬之左參政車〔璽〕、右參政劉約、左參議馬〔駉〕、右參議田彭、副使閻〔璽〕、楊〔壽〕、鄭〔端〕、僉事席〔書〕、薛〔英〕、韓〔鼐〕。於時，鎮守太監廖〔堂〕、清戎監察御史馬〔騤〕，實共參懷，務期作
translation_en: …and the Assistant Instructors Zhu Zuyuan, Lu Fen, Wang Chaochen, Zhang Lu, and Wang Ying. Providing for all expenses and instructing and admonishing the various offices were entrusted to Left Provincial Administration Commissioner Zhang Zilin and Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Nan Tang. Prohibiting favoritism, suppressing fraud, and preventing wrongdoing and illicit conduct [?] were entrusted to Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Zhu En and Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Zhong Ben. All other functionaries were selected for their ability. These were all concerned with affairs inside the examination compound. Affairs outside it were entrusted to Left Administration Vice Commissioner Che Xi, Right Administration Vice Commissioner Liu Yue, Left Assistant Administration Commissioner Ma Jiong, Right Assistant Administration Commissioner Tian Peng, Surveillance Vice Commissioners Yan Xi, Yang Shou, and Zheng Duan, and Assistant Surveillance Commissioners Xi Shu, Xue Ying, and Han Nai. At this time, Regional Defender, Grand Eunuch Liao Tang, and Investigating Censor Ma Kui, charged with inspecting military affairs, also jointly participated in the deliberations [?], striving to bring about…

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
興先是司禮監右少監閻
〔宣〕戶部右侍郎林〔泮〕刑部
左侍郎王〔鑑之〕錦衣衛指揮
使韋〔順〕奉
勑按事於河南之南鄙御史〔陽〕
與在聯事乘遽而會於南
〔陽〕諸使者以貢興務重勸
===
之遄歸不然明日既迫事
殷慮煩亦未必能專一詳
緩致整暇若是也處分既
畢官僚其方自始迄終無
愆違者終事取士八十人
制額所拘弗敢過也薦書成以
序見屬〔恂〕惟
punctuated:
興。先是，司禮監右少監閻〔宣〕、戶部右侍郎林〔泮〕、刑部左侍郎王〔鑑之〕、錦衣衛指揮使韋〔順〕奉勑按事於河南之南鄙。御史〔陽〕與在聯事，乘遽而會於南〔陽〕。諸使者以貢興務重，勸之遄歸。不然，明日既迫，事殷慮煩，亦未必能專一詳緩，致整暇若是也。
處分既畢，官僚其方，自始迄終無愆違者。終事，取士八十人，制額所拘，弗敢過也。薦書成，以序見屬。〔恂〕惟
translation_en:
…encouragement. Before this, Yan Xuan, Right Junior Director of the Directorate of Ceremonial; Lin Pan, Right Vice Minister of Revenue; Wang Jianzhi, Left Vice Minister of Justice; and Wei Shun, Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, had received an imperial order to investigate affairs on Henan’s southern border. Censor Yang participated in their joint business and traveled by express relay to meet them at Nanyang. Considering the importance of recommending candidates [?], the commissioners urged him to return promptly. Otherwise, with the next day already pressing near, business abundant, and concerns numerous, he might not have been able to give matters such undivided, careful, and unhurried attention, or to achieve such order and composure.
Once the arrangements were complete, the officials attended to their respective duties [?], without error or breach from beginning to end. At the conclusion, eighty candidates were selected. Bound by the prescribed quota, we dared not exceed it. When the recommendation register was complete, I was asked to provide a preface. I, Xun, reflect that…

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
國朝釆唐宋之制以文取士
或謂異乎成周鄉舉里選
之法竊不謂然漁之網笱
罶罩不必同而同期於得
魚畋之弓矢罘罝不必同
而同期於得禽選舉之法
雖五帝三王亦異其制期
===
於得士而已矣何必同哉
且古人之所謂文有謂經
天緯地者有謂道德純備
者有謂勤學好問者有謂
懋民惠禮錫民爵位者夫
大極於財成輔相小極於
講習討論內極於盡性至
punctuated:
國朝釆唐宋之制，以文取士。或謂異乎成周鄉舉里選之法，竊不謂然。漁之網笱罶罩不必同，而同期於得魚；畋之弓矢罘罝不必同，而同期於得禽。選舉之法，雖五帝三王亦異其制，期於得士而已矣，何必同哉？

且古人之所謂文，有謂經天緯地者，有謂道德純備者，有謂勤學好問者，有謂懋民惠禮、錫民爵位者。夫大極於財成輔相，小極於講習討論，內極於盡性至
translation_en:
… Our dynasty has adopted the institutions of the Tang and Song, selecting men for office through literary accomplishment. Some say that this differs from the system of nomination in the townships and selection in the villages under the Zhou. I venture to disagree. The nets, bamboo traps, basket traps, and cover traps used in fishing need not be alike, yet all share the aim of catching fish. The bows, arrows, and nets used in hunting need not be alike, yet all share the aim of taking game. Even among the Five Emperors and Three Kings, the institutions for selecting and recommending men differed. Their aim was simply to obtain worthy men. Why must their methods be identical?

Moreover, what the ancients called wen—cultural and literary accomplishment—was variously described as ordering Heaven and Earth; possessing the Way and virtue in their purity and completeness; studying diligently and being eager to inquire; and encouraging the people, graciously providing ritual instruction, and bestowing ranks and offices upon them. In its broadest scope, it extends to shaping and assisting the workings of Heaven and Earth; in its narrower scope, to study, practice, discussion, and inquiry; inwardly, to fully realizing one’s nature and attaining …

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
命而外極於輔世匡時語
文而至於是殆無以復加
矣此豈薄物細故而可少
之以爲不足以得士乎若
謂令之所取在於詞章非
此之謂則凡文在其中者
渀動充滿憤盈發洩心聲
===
章匠落紙自然雖云詞章
發由性命此尚不足以得
士邪而東坡蘇氏乃謂較
之以聲律取之以糊名而
異人出焉非人之力歸於
天相誠疑非至論也前輩
論文士並稱韓歐歐之言
punctuated: 命，而外極於輔世匡時。語文而至於是，殆無以復加矣。此豈薄物細故，而可少之，以爲不足以得士乎？若謂令之所取在於詞章，非此之謂，則凡文在其中者，渀動充滿，憤盈發洩，心聲章匠，落紙自然。雖云詞章，發由性命，此尚不足以得士邪？而東坡蘇氏乃謂：「較之以聲律，取之以糊名，而異人出焉。」非人之力，歸於天相，誠疑非至論也。前輩論文士，並稱韓歐。歐之言，
translation_en:
…one’s Heaven-endowed destiny, while outwardly extending to assisting the world and setting the age right. When writing is spoken of in these terms, scarcely anything further can be added. Could this be a trifling matter, to be belittled as insufficient for selecting worthy men? If one says that what the present regulations select for [?] is literary composition, rather than what is meant here, then consider all those who possess literary substance within: it surges and fills them, brimming over and finding expression; the voice of the heart takes crafted form [?], flowing naturally onto the page. Though called literary composition, it springs from their nature and Heaven-endowed destiny. Is even this insufficient for selecting worthy men?

Yet Su Shi, known as Dongpo, said: “They are compared on the basis of prosody and selected with their names concealed, and outstanding men emerge.” To attribute this to Heaven’s assistance rather than human effort seems, indeed, hardly a definitive judgment. In discussing masters of writing, our predecessors named Han Yu and Ouyang Xiu together. Ouyang’s words …

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
曰我所謂文必與道俱是
文與道猶二物也至韓之
原道則謂其文詩書易春
秋正符朱子道之顯者之
意卓識精論逈異歐說聖
人復起不易斯言即詞章
之文根本淵源其深猶若
===
此而南豐曾氏又謂文章
得失繫於治亂其重又若
此由是觀之則我
朝以文取士比之成周之法
何必多讓而得士之盛則
亦何愧哉抑語有之志存
焉學不至焉不可也學存
punctuated: 曰：「我所謂文，必與道俱。」是文與道猶二物也。至韓之《原道》，則謂：「其文，《詩》《書》《易》《春秋》。」正符朱子「道之顯者」之意。卓識精論，逈異歐說。聖人復起，不易斯言。即詞章之文，根本淵源，其深猶若此。而南豐曾氏又謂：「文章得失，繫於治亂。」其重又若此。由是觀之，則我朝以文取士，比之成周之法，何必多讓？而得士之盛，則亦何愧哉？抑語有之：「志存焉，學不至焉，不可也；學存
translation_en: …says: “What I call writing must always accompany the Way.” This still treats writing and the Way as two separate things. But Han Yu, in his Inquiry into the Way (Yuan dao), says: “Its writings are the Book of Odes, the Book of Documents, the Book of Changes, and the Spring and Autumn Annals.” This precisely accords with Zhu Xi’s conception of “the manifest expression of the Way.” Such outstanding insight and penetrating argument differ markedly from Ouyang Xiu’s account. Were a sage to arise again, he would not alter these words. Even literary composition has roots and sources as profound as these. Moreover, Zeng Gong of Nanfeng said: “Success and failure in writing are bound up with order and disorder in government.” Its importance is thus equally great. Viewed in this light, why should our dynasty’s selection of men through writing need to yield much to the methods of the fully established Zhou dynasty? And in the abundance of worthy men it has obtained, what cause has it for shame? Yet there is a saying: “If the aspiration is there but learning falls short, that will not do; if learning is there…

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
馬辭不至焉不可也辭存
焉時不至焉不可也今諸
生之志與學與文皆至矣
所需者時耳而方值
聖天子建中立極董正訓勵四
海之士莫不洗濯其心以
嚮風承德眞其時也諸生
===
行且季
制科服官政循資而往公卿可
致其所以立功立事以見
於世者於古人之所謂文
苟有一焉亦足不朽而況
其備乎諸生其勉之〔恂 　革〕
所以處懷期物者蓋無以
punctuated: 馬，辭不至焉，不可也；辭存焉，時不至焉，不可也。今諸生之志與學與文皆至矣，所需者時耳。而方值聖天子建中立極，董正訓勵，四海之士莫不洗濯其心，以嚮風承德，眞其時也。諸生行且季制科，服官政，循資而往，公卿可致。其所以立功立事，以見於世者，於古人之所謂文，苟有一焉，亦足不朽，而況其備乎？諸生其勉之！〔恂 　革〕所以處懷期物者，蓋無以
translation_en: … [?] if expression does not attain the requisite standard, that will not do; if expression is present but the proper time has not arrived, that too will not do. Now your aspirations, learning, and literary accomplishment have all attained that standard; all you require is the right time. You happen to live just when the sage Son of Heaven is establishing the mean and setting the supreme standard, supervising, rectifying, instructing, and encouraging. Scholars throughout the realm are all cleansing their hearts to respond to his influence and receive his virtue. This is indeed the right time. You will soon succeed in the examinations established by imperial decree [?], undertake official duties, and advance according to your qualifications and seniority; the ranks of dukes and ministers will be within reach. In establishing achievements and undertakings that make your mark upon the world, if you possess even one aspect of what the ancients called cultural accomplishment, that will suffice to make your name endure. How much more so if you possess it in full! Strive, gentlemen! 〔Xun Ge [?]〕 As for the convictions I cherish and the expectations I hold for others, there is surely nothing with which …

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
易此矣其毋曰吾何安於
是是非予言也是周公之
所謂文也
陝西鳳翔府儒學教授李
怡謹序
punctuated:
易此矣。其毋曰：「吾何安於是？」是非予言也，是周公之所謂文也。
陝西鳳翔府儒學教授李怡謹序。
translation_en:
…depart from this. Let them not say, “How can I rest content with this?” These are not my words; this is what the Duke of Zhou meant by cultural accomplishment (wen).
Preface respectfully composed by Li Yi, Professor of the Confucian School of Fengxiang Prefecture, Shaanxi.

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
正德二年河南鄉試
監臨官
巡按河南監察御史鄭陽〔宗乾直隸安肅縣人丙辰進士〕
提調官
河南等處承宣布政使司左布政使張子麟〔元瑞直隸藁城縣人甲辰進士〕
河南等處承宣布政使司右布政使南鏜〔彥聲陝西商州人甲辰進士〕
監試官
河南等處提刑按察司按察使宋恩〔汝承直隸華亭縣人甲辰進士〕
河南等處提刑按察司僉事□本〔與立直隸寶應縣人庚戌進士〕
===
考試官
陝西鳳翔府儒學教授李恂〔子實山西霍州人己酉貢士〕
順天府涿州儒學學正秦鎰〔國聲直隸無錫縣人壬子貢士〕
同考試官
直隸松江府上海縣儒學教諭李翰〔文卿廣東新會縣人壬子貢士〕
山東青州府臨朐縣儒學教諭郭基〔維德浙江東陽縣人乙卯貢士〕
直隸廬州府舒城縣儒學教諭倪域〔邦正福建建安縣人戊午貢士〕
浙江杭州府海寧縣儒學訓導朱祖元〔廷望江西豐城縣人己酉貢士〕
順天府固安縣儒學訓導逯瑱〔克諧山東章丘縣人甲子貢士〕
punctuated:
正德二年河南鄉試。

監臨官：
巡按河南監察御史鄭陽〔宗乾，直隸安肅縣人，丙辰進士〕。

提調官：
河南等處承宣布政使司左布政使張子麟〔元瑞，直隸藁城縣人，甲辰進士〕。
河南等處承宣布政使司右布政使南鏜〔彥聲，陝西商州人，甲辰進士〕。

監試官：
河南等處提刑按察司按察使宋恩〔汝承，直隸華亭縣人，甲辰進士〕。
河南等處提刑按察司僉事□本〔與立，直隸寶應縣人，庚戌進士〕。

考試官：
陝西鳳翔府儒學教授李恂〔子實，山西霍州人，己酉貢士〕。
順天府涿州儒學學正秦鎰〔國聲，直隸無錫縣人，壬子貢士〕。

同考試官：
直隸松江府上海縣儒學教諭李翰〔文卿，廣東新會縣人，壬子貢士〕。
山東青州府臨朐縣儒學教諭郭基〔維德，浙江東陽縣人，乙卯貢士〕。
直隸廬州府舒城縣儒學教諭倪域〔邦正，福建建安縣人，戊午貢士〕。
浙江杭州府海寧縣儒學訓導朱祖元〔廷望，江西豐城縣人，己酉貢士〕。
順天府固安縣儒學訓導逯瑱〔克諧，山東章丘縣人，甲子貢士〕。
translation_en:
Henan Provincial Examination, second year of Zhengde (1507).

Supervising Official:
Zheng Yang, Investigating Censor serving as Regional Inspector of Henan. His courtesy name was Zongqian; he was from Ansu County, Zhili, and was a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the bingchen year.

Proctors:
Zhang Zilin, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of Henan. His courtesy name was Yuanrui; he was from Gaocheng County, Zhili, and was a metropolitan graduate of the jiachen year.
Nan Tang, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Henan. His courtesy name was Yansheng; he was from Shangzhou, Shaanxi, and was a metropolitan graduate of the jiachen year.

Examination Oversight Officials:
Song En, Provincial Surveillance Commissioner of Henan. His courtesy name was Rucheng; he was from Huating County, Zhili, and was a metropolitan graduate of the jiachen year.
□ Ben [surname illegible], Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of Henan. His courtesy name was Yuli; he was from Baoying County, Zhili, and was a metropolitan graduate of the gengxu year.

Examiners:

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
克己復禮爲仁
博學所以載物也高明所以覆物也
智之實知斯二者弗去是也
易
忠信所以進德也修辭立其誠所以居業
也
巽而止剛中而應是以大亨
===
備物致用立成器以爲天下利莫大乎聖
人
乾健也坤順也震動也巽入也坎陷也離
麗也艮止也兌說也
八音克諧無相奪倫
惟學遜志務時敏厥脩乃來允懷于茲道
積于厥躬惟斅學半念終始典于學
厥德脩罔覺
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

克己復禮爲仁。

博學所以載物也，高明所以覆物也。

智之實，知斯二者弗去是也。

易

忠信所以進德也，修辭立其誠，所以居業也。

巽而止，剛中而應，是以大亨。

備物致用，立成器以爲天下利，莫大乎聖人。

乾健也，坤順也，震動也，巽入也，坎陷也，離麗也，艮止也，兌說也。

八音克諧，無相奪倫。

惟學遜志，務時敏，厥脩乃來。允懷于茲，道積于厥躬。惟斅學半，念終始典于學，厥德脩罔覺。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

To restrain oneself and return to ritual propriety is benevolence.

Broad learning is the means by which one sustains all things; loftiness and illumination are the means by which one encompasses all things.

The substance of wisdom is to understand these two things and not depart from them.

Book of Changes

Loyalty and trustworthiness are the means of advancing virtue. Refining one's words and establishing sincerity are the means of abiding in one's undertaking.

Gentle and yet still, with the firm line central and finding a corresponding line: hence great success.

In preparing things for use and establishing finished implements for the benefit of all under Heaven, none surpasses the sage.

Qian means strength; Kun, compliance; Zhen, movement; Xun, penetration; Kan, a pitfall; Li, attachment; Gen, stillness; and Dui, joy.

Let the eight kinds of musical sound harmonize, without any disrupting the proper order of the others.

In learning, make your will humble and strive always to be diligent; then cultivation will follow. Truly cherish this, and the Way will accumulate within your person. Teaching is half of learning. From beginning to end, keep your thoughts constantly on learning, and your virtue will be cultivated without your being aware of it.

天保定爾亦孔之固俾爾單厚何福不除
俾爾多益以莫不庶
虎拜稽首天子萬年
憬彼淮夷來獻其琛
春秋
公伐齊納糾　齊小白入于齊〔莊公九年〕
宋公陳侯衛侯曹伯會晉師于棐林伐鄭
〔宣公元年〕
punctuated:
予嘉乃德，曰篤不忘，上帝時歆，下民祗協。
唐虞稽古，建官惟百，內有百揆、四岳，外有州牧、侯伯，庶政惟和，萬國咸寧。夏商官倍，亦克用乂。明王立政，不惟其官，惟其人。
詩
采采芣苢，薄言采之。采采芣苢，薄言有之。采采芣苢，薄言掇之。采采芣苢，薄言捋之。采采芣苢，薄言袺之。采采芣苢，薄言襭之。
天保定爾，亦孔之固。俾爾單厚，何福不除？俾爾多益，以莫不庶。
虎拜稽首，天子萬年！
憬彼淮夷，來獻其琛。
春秋
公伐齊納糾，齊小白入于齊。〔莊公九年〕
宋公、陳侯、衛侯、曹伯會晉師于棐林，伐鄭。〔宣公元年〕
translation_en:
I commend your virtue: it is steadfast and never forgetful. The Lord on High accepts your offerings, and the people below reverently unite in harmony.
Tang and Yu examined antiquity and established only a hundred offices. At court were the Director of the Hundred Affairs and the Four Mountains; outside were regional governors and the lords of the states. All affairs of government were harmoniously managed, and the myriad states were at peace. Xia and Shang doubled the number of offices, yet also achieved good government. When an enlightened king establishes government, what matters is not the offices but the people who hold them.

Book of Odes
We gather, gather the plantain; we pick it. We gather, gather the plantain; we bring it in. We gather, gather the plantain; we pluck it. We gather, gather the plantain; we strip it by the handful. We gather, gather the plantain; we hold it in our lifted skirts. We gather, gather the plantain; we tuck our skirts into our belts to carry it.
Heaven protects and secures you, with exceeding firmness. It makes your blessings abundant and substantial: what blessing does it not bestow? It grants you increase upon increase, so that nothing fails to flourish.
Hu bowed and touched his head to the ground: “May the Son of Heaven live ten thousand years!”
Those distant Huai Yi come to present their treasures.

Spring and Autumn Annals
The duke attacked Qi to install Jiu. Xiaobai of Qi entered Qi. 〔Ninth year of Duke Zhuang.〕
The Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Wei, and the Earl of Cao joined the army of Jin at Feilin and attacked Zheng. 〔First year of Duke Xuan.〕

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
楚師鄭師侵衛　公會楚公子嬰齊于蜀
〔成公二年〕
公會劉子晉侯宋公蔡侯衛侯陳子鄭伯
許男曹伯莒子邾子頓子胡子滕子
薛伯杞伯小邾子齊國夏子召陵侵
楚　蔡侯以吳子及楚人戰于柏舉
楚師敗績〔俱定公四年〕
===
禮記
是故天時雨澤君子達亹亹焉
然後立之學等使其節奏省其文采以繩
德厚律小大之稱比終始之序以象
事行使親疏貴賤長幼男女之理皆
形見於樂
及夫日月星辰民所瞻仰也山林川谷丘
陵民所取財用也
民入孝弟出尊長養老而后成教成教而
后國可安也
第貳場
punctuated:
楚師、鄭師侵衛。公會楚公子嬰齊于蜀。〔成公二年〕
公會劉子、晉侯、宋公、蔡侯、衛侯、陳子、鄭伯、許男、曹伯、莒子、邾子、頓子、胡子、滕子、薛伯、杞伯、小邾子、齊國夏子召陵侵楚。蔡侯以吳子及楚人戰于柏舉，楚師敗績。〔俱定公四年〕
禮記
是故天時雨澤，君子達亹亹焉。
然後立之學等，使其節奏省其文采，以繩德厚，律小大之稱，比終始之序，以象事行，使親疏、貴賤、長幼、男女之理皆形見於樂。
及夫日月星辰，民所瞻仰也；山林川谷丘陵，民所取財用也。
民入孝弟，出尊長，養老而后成教，成教而后國可安也。
第貳場
translation_en:
The armies of Chu and Zheng invaded Wei. The duke met Prince Yingqi of Chu at Shu. 〔Second year of Duke Cheng.〕

The duke met the Viscount of Liu, the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Cai, the Marquis of Wei, the Viscount of Chen, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, the Earl of Cao, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, the Viscount of Dun, the Viscount of Hu, the Viscount of Teng, the Earl of Xue, the Earl of Qi 杞, the Viscount of Lesser Zhu, and Guo Xia of Qi 齊 at [?] Zhaoling to invade Chu. The Marquis of Cai, with the Viscount of Wu, fought the men of Chu at Baiju. The army of Chu suffered a crushing defeat. 〔Both entries are from the fourth year of Duke Ding.〕

Book of Rites

Thus Heaven provides rain and moisture in their season, and the gentleman tirelessly brings things to fulfillment.

Then they establish graded levels of instruction, ensuring that the rhythms and measures restrain the embellishments, so as to regulate the cultivation of substantial virtue. They regulate the appropriate balance of great and small and arrange the sequence from beginning to end to represent the conduct of affairs, so that the principles governing close and distant kin, noble and lowly, elder and younger, and male and female are all manifest in music.

As for the sun, moon, and stars, these are what the people look up to; mountains, forests, rivers, valleys, hills, and mounds are where the people obtain their resources and necessities.

When the people are filial and respectful toward elder brothers at home, honor their elders outside the home, and provide for the aged, moral instruction is brought to completion. Only when moral instruction is complete can the state be secure.

Second Session

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
天下都會南莫壯於金陵北莫雄於幽
冀我
太祖高皇帝建都金陵據南方之全勝
太宗文皇帝遷都北平控北方之上游二都形
勝載于
大明一統志諸書可參攷矣然自古北可以馭
南而南不可以統北自周迄今歷可數
者我
□聖□□不及此□公矣
===
□□移鼎□□□世永□
祖宗神謨聖筭固有在歟今天下疆域北則至
於胡漠南則抵於交阯我
太祖高皇帝北驅胡元設大寧都司于燕薊東
北
太宗文皇帝南平交阯設都布按三司于九眞
日南二域顚末載于
國朝大學衍義補諸書可互推矣是皆域中
闢壤宇內山河尺地寸金不可棄者遠
punctuated: 天下都會，南莫壯於金陵，北莫雄於幽冀。我太祖高皇帝建都金陵，據南方之全勝；太宗文皇帝遷都北平，控北方之上游。二都形勝，載于《大明一統志》諸書，可參攷矣。然自古北可以馭南，而南不可以統北，自周迄今，歷可數者。我□聖□□不及此□公矣。□□移鼎□□□世永□，祖宗神謨聖筭，固有在歟？今天下疆域，北則至於胡漠，南則抵於交阯。我太祖高皇帝北驅胡元，設大寧都司于燕薊東北；太宗文皇帝南平交阯，設都布按三司于九眞、日南。二域顚末，載于國朝《大學衍義補》諸書，可互推矣。是皆域中闢壤，宇內山河，尺地寸金，不可棄者。遠
translation_en:
…among the great cities of the realm, none in the south is more imposing than Jinling, and none in the north more commanding than You and Ji. Our Emperor Taizu Gao established his capital at Jinling, occupying a site that commanded all the advantages of the south; Emperor Taizong Wen moved the capital to Beiping, controlling the strategically dominant reaches of the north. The strategic terrain of the two capitals is recorded in such books as the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Great Ming, which may be consulted. Yet since antiquity, the north has been able to govern the south, whereas the south has been unable to rule the north: instances can be enumerated from the Zhou down to the present. Our … sage … does not reach this … impartial [?]. … moving the dynastic tripods [transferring the capital] … generations … enduring [?]. Surely the divine plans and sagely calculations of the imperial ancestors had their reasons?

The present territory of the realm extends north to the deserts of the Hu and south to Jiaozhi. Our Emperor Taizu Gao drove out the Mongol Yuan to the north and established the Daning Regional Military Commission northeast of Yan and Ji. Emperor Taizong Wen pacified Jiaozhi to the south and established the three provincial agencies—the Regional Military Commission, Provincial Administration Commission, and Provincial Surveillance Commission—in Jiuzhen and Rinan. The histories of these two territories are recorded in such works of our dynasty as the Supplement to the Extended Meaning of the Great Learning, whose accounts may be compared. These were all lands opened up within the realm, mountains and rivers within the empire: every foot of land was worth an inch of gold and could not be abandoned. In earlier times [?], …

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
我
太宗繼統徙大寧都司於關內
宣宗纘業隸交址郡縣於安南
二聖繼志述事固有居歟繼今
聖子神孫固都會於靈長壽疆域於悠久繼體
守成之道固具存也諸士行將觀光
上都宣政遐荒願有以鳴其
盛
問上古書契以代結繩之政而文
===
籍生焉五典八索九丘相繼而出
吾夫子觀史記之浩繁懼覽者之不一
遂刪詩書定禮樂賛周易脩春秋餘皆
黜之然後六經之道煥然明著秦收天
下詩書百家語詣守尉雜燒之六經盡
被燔滅矣而今東考六經若皆全書缺
文斷簡槩不多見有若未遭秦火然者
想得漢儒口傳家蓄旁搜廣索以致是
爾若然漢儒之功亦大矣最可稱者幾
punctuated:
我太宗繼統，徙大寧都司於關內；宣宗纘業，隸交址郡縣於安南。二聖繼志述事，固有居歟？繼今，聖子神孫固都會於靈長，壽疆域於悠久，繼體守成之道固具存也。諸士行將觀光上都，宣政遐荒，願有以鳴其盛。
問：上古書契以代結繩之政，而文籍生焉。五典、八索、九丘相繼而出。吾夫子觀史記之浩繁，懼覽者之不一，遂刪詩書，定禮樂，賛周易，脩春秋，餘皆黜之。然後六經之道煥然明著。秦收天下，詩書百家語詣守尉雜燒之，六經盡被燔滅矣。而今東考六經，若皆全書，缺文斷簡槩不多見，有若未遭秦火然者。想得漢儒口傳家蓄，旁搜廣索，以致是爾。若然，漢儒之功亦大矣。最可稱者幾
translation_en:
…Our Emperor Taizong succeeded to the throne and moved the Daning Regional Military Commission within the passes; Emperor Xuanzong continued the imperial enterprise and placed the prefectures and counties of Jiaozhi under Annam. In carrying forward their predecessors’ intentions and accomplishments, surely these two sage emperors had grounds for their actions [?]. Henceforth, may their sagely sons and divine grandsons secure the capital’s enduring prosperity and preserve the realm’s borders forever: the principles for succeeding to the throne and preserving inherited achievements are fully present here. You gentlemen will soon behold the splendor of the imperial capital and extend its government to distant regions. I hope you will find words to proclaim this flourishing age.
Question: In high antiquity, written records replaced government by knotted cords, and written texts came into being. The Five Canons, Eight Cords, and Nine Mounds appeared in succession. Our Master Confucius surveyed the vast profusion of historical records and feared that readers would lack a common understanding. He therefore edited the Odes and Documents, established the Rites and Music, elucidated the Changes of Zhou, and compiled the Spring and Autumn Annals, rejecting all the rest. Only then did the Way of the Six Classics become radiantly clear. When Qin brought All-under-Heaven under its rule, copies of the Odes and Documents and the writings of the various philosophical masters were brought to the governors and commandants and burned together. The Six Classics were all consumed and destroyed. Yet when we now examine [?] the Six Classics, they seem to be complete books: missing passages and broken bamboo slips are generally seldom encountered. It is as though they had never suffered the Qin fires. Presumably this resulted from Han scholars’ oral transmission, preservation of texts in their households, and extensive searches far and wide. If so, the contribution of the Han scholars was indeed great. How many were most worthy of praise…

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
何六哉先儒有曰經不亡於秦火而壞
於漢儒其與漢儒毋迺過於已甚乎今
之窮六經者漢儒之說悉置不論易惟
本程子之傳朱子之本義書本蔡傳詩
本朱傳春秋本胡傳禮樂本陳澔氏之
集說書詩禮樂不聞異議程子易傳有
謂不看本文自成一書者胡氏春秋傳
有謂多牽強處不合聖意者程胡之見
果不□□者是耶爽之旨比諸書
===
禮有□□又謂□失之賊書失之
誣詩失之愚春秋失之亂禮樂失之煩
奢是果爲經發歟抑爲傳發歟學者之
於六經猶布帛菽粟□用而不可缺者
也至此必有定論焉
問封建者先王之制壇鐵者後王之法自
秦罷封建之設而易以郡縣後世卒莫
能復有欲復者時議曉曉事竟以寢自
管仲興魚鹽之利而重以權法後世卒
punctuated:
何六哉？先儒有曰：「經不亡於秦火，而壞於漢儒。」其與漢儒，毋迺過於已甚乎？今之窮六經者，漢儒之說悉置不論。易惟本程子之傳、朱子之本義，書本蔡傳，詩本朱傳，春秋本胡傳，禮樂本陳澔氏之集說。書詩禮樂不聞異議，程子易傳有謂不看本文自成一書者，胡氏春秋傳有謂多牽強處、不合聖意者。程胡之見，果不□□者是耶？爽之旨，比諸書禮有□□。又謂：「□失之賊，書失之誣，詩失之愚，春秋失之亂，禮樂失之煩奢。」是果爲經發歟，抑爲傳發歟？學者之於六經，猶布帛菽粟□用而不可缺者也。至此必有定論焉。

問：封建者，先王之制；壇鐵者，後王之法。自秦罷封建之設，而易以郡縣，後世卒莫能復。有欲復者，時議曉曉，事竟以寢。自管仲興魚鹽之利，而重以權法，後世卒
translation_en:
…how many—six? [?] An earlier Confucian scholar said: “The Classics were not destroyed by the Qin book burning, but were corrupted by the Han Confucians.” Is this not excessively harsh in its treatment of the Han Confucians? Those who now investigate the Six Classics set aside all the explanations of Han scholars without discussion. For the Book of Changes, they rely exclusively on Master Cheng’s Commentary and Master Zhu’s Original Meaning; for the Book of Documents, on Cai’s Commentary; for the Book of Odes, on Zhu’s Commentary; for the Spring and Autumn Annals, on Hu’s Commentary; and for rites and music, on Chen Hao’s Collected Explanations. No dissenting opinions are heard concerning the Documents, Odes, rites, and music. Of Master Cheng’s Commentary on the Changes, however, some say that it constitutes a book in its own right without reference to the original text. Of Hu’s Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals, some say that many passages are strained and do not accord with the sage’s intent. Are Cheng’s and Hu’s interpretations indeed not …, and are those who … correct? [?] The purport of “divergence,” compared with the Documents and Rites, has … [?]. It is also said: “The failing of □ is harm; that of the Documents, misrepresentation; that of the Odes, foolishness; that of the Spring and Autumn Annals, disorder; and that of rites and music, excessive elaboration and extravagance.” Are these remarks really directed at the Classics, or at their commentaries? For scholars, the Six Classics are like cloth, silk, beans, and grain—□ used and indispensable [?]. On these matters there must be a settled judgment.

Question: Enfeoffment was an institution of the ancient kings; “altar and iron” [?; apparently salt and iron] was a policy of later rulers. Since the Qin abolished enfeoffment and replaced it with commanderies and counties, later ages have never succeeded in restoring it. When some wished to restore it, contemporary debate grew clamorous, and the undertaking was ultimately shelved. Since Guan Zhong developed revenues from fish and salt and reinforced them with measures of economic regulation, later ages have ultimately …

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
莫能罷有欲罷者國用岌岌事復旋行
唐柳宗元論議封建勢不可復宋儒胡
致堂力破其說至千百言不衰後之君
子多是胡而非柳以今折衷二家之論
竟孰長歟漢丞相御史建白鹽鐵有資
國用當時賢良文學力辯其事至千萬
言不已以今權衡二家之論竟孰便歟
我
□家封建□親□侯髣髴今三代近日分封
===
日廣□給有司□請
當宁僅能借役足此迄無善術哉
國家經理鹽鐵法意遠過於漢唐近日法制
論敝邊費缺供
朝廷累遣憲臣僅能因陋就簡未見良法夫
二事關於今日正不細也方來日復一
日不知何處而後可諸士平居未試則
曰天下無難處之事今問有及試爲我
言之
punctuated:
莫能罷。有欲罷者，國用岌岌，事復旋行。唐柳宗元論議封建，勢不可復；宋儒胡致堂力破其說，至千百言不衰。後之君子多是胡而非柳。以今折衷二家之論，竟孰長歟？漢丞相御史建白鹽鐵有資國用，當時賢良文學力辯其事，至千萬言不已。以今權衡二家之論，竟孰便歟？我□家封建□親□侯，髣髴今三代。近日分封日廣，□給有司□請，當宁僅能借役足此，迄無善術哉？
國家經理鹽鐵，法意遠過於漢唐。近日法制論敝，邊費缺供，朝廷累遣憲臣，僅能因陋就簡，未見良法。夫二事關於今日，正不細也。方來日復一日，不知何處而後可。諸士平居未試，則曰天下無難處之事。今問有及，試爲我言之。
translation_en:
…none could abolish it. When some wished to do so, the state’s finances became precarious, and the practice was promptly resumed. Liu Zongyuan of the Tang argued that enfeoffment could not, under prevailing circumstances, be restored. The Song Confucian Hu Zhitang vigorously refuted his argument, writing hundreds and thousands of words without flagging. Later scholars have mostly approved of Hu and rejected Liu. Judging between their arguments today, which is ultimately superior? The Han Chancellor and Censor-in-chief submitted that salt and iron revenues helped meet state expenditures. The Worthies and Literati of the time vigorously disputed the matter, continuing for thousands and tens of thousands of words. Weighing their respective arguments today, which is ultimately more advantageous? Our □ dynasty enfeoffs □ imperial relatives and □ nobles [?], resembling the Three Dynasties of antiquity [?]. Recently, enfeoffments have grown ever more numerous. The responsible offices petition concerning □ provision [?], and the sovereign can barely meet these needs by borrowing labor services [?]. Is there still no sound method?
In administering salt and iron, the state’s legislative intentions far surpass those of the Han and Tang. Recently, the regulations have become defective [?], and supplies fall short of frontier expenditures. The court has repeatedly dispatched censorial officials, but they have only managed to make do with inadequate arrangements; no sound method has yet appeared. These two matters are of no small consequence today. As the days ahead follow one upon another, we do not know how they can be satisfactorily handled. You scholars, in ordinary life before being put to the test, say that nothing in the world is difficult to deal with. Now that these matters have been raised in a question, try to explain them to me.

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
問景行先哲學者事也且以河南言之中
州文物之盛甲於天下其見於經傳者
若輔商湯而成格天之業相周宣而擅
中興之美者卓乎不可尚也然相鄭稱
古之遺愛而刑書之鑄或見譏於賢者
守頴爲治行第一而鶡雀上言或不滿
於時論開元之治姚張首稱而二人每
相牙者豈其所見不同歟慶曆之盛韓
富最二公間生兼濟豈其所見或
===
異歟　封八轍爰遣毋感悟君心而
或者賞其忠孝之兼有其義何居有爲
家世志於復讎終成漢業而議者稱其
節智之兩全其理何在杖策軍門者能
中興於漢而嚅手燕雲者卒不能揚天
山之旆天耶人耶旋乾轉坤者能綿祚
於宋而情同魚水者竟不能嘘炎爐之
燼人耶天耶兄弟同倡道學與兄弟連
魁天下者孰得父子同立戰功與父子
punctuated: 問：景行先哲，學者事也。且以河南言之，中州文物之盛甲於天下。其見於經傳者，若輔商湯而成格天之業、相周宣而擅中興之美者，卓乎不可尚也。然相鄭稱古之遺愛，而刑書之鑄或見譏於賢者；守頴爲治行第一，而鶡雀上言或不滿於時論。開元之治，姚張首稱，而二人每相牙者，豈其所見不同歟？慶曆之盛，韓富最，二公間生兼濟，豈其所見或異歟？封八轍爰遣毋，感悟君心，而或者賞其忠孝之兼有，其義何居？有爲家世志於復讎，終成漢業，而議者稱其節智之兩全，其理何在？杖策軍門者能中興於漢，而嚅手燕雲者卒不能揚天山之旆，天耶？人耶？旋乾轉坤者能綿祚於宋，而情同魚水者竟不能嘘炎爐之燼，人耶？天耶？兄弟同倡道學與兄弟連魁天下者孰得？父子同立戰功與父子
translation_en:
Question: To look up to and emulate the wise men of the past is the scholar’s task. To speak specifically of Henan, the flourishing cultural achievements of the Central Province rank foremost in the empire. Among its men recorded in the classics and their commentaries, those who assisted Tang of Shang in accomplishing deeds that reached Heaven, or served as chief minister to King Xuan of Zhou and won renown for restoring the dynasty, stand so high that none can surpass them. Yet the minister of Zheng was praised as having inherited the benevolence of antiquity, while his casting of the penal statutes drew criticism from worthy men. The governor of Ying ranked first for administrative achievement, yet his report concerning the he bird and sparrows [?] did not wholly satisfy contemporary opinion.

For the good government of the Kaiyuan era, Yao and Zhang receive foremost praise. Yet the two repeatedly opposed one another [?]: was this because their views differed? For the flourishing government of the Qingli era, Han and Fu were preeminent. These two lords, born at rare intervals and bringing aid to all [?]—did their views perhaps differ?

The person described in the garbled phrase 封八轍爰遣毋 [?] moved the ruler’s heart to understanding, and some praised him for possessing both loyalty and filial devotion. What is the meaning of this? Another, intent on avenging his family’s service to its former rulers, ultimately helped establish the Han imperial enterprise; commentators praised him for fully combining integrity and wisdom. What is the principle behind this?

The man who came with staff in hand to the army’s gate was able to restore the Han, while the man who hesitated over Yan and Yun [?] ultimately could not raise his banners over the Tianshan mountains. Was this Heaven’s doing, or man’s? The man who turned Heaven and Earth around was able to prolong the Song’s imperial mandate, while the man whose bond with his ruler was like that of fish and water ultimately could not breathe the furnace’s embers back into flame. Was this man’s doing, or Heaven’s?

Of brothers who together promoted the Learning of the Way and brothers who successively ranked first in the empire’s examinations, which better attained their aim? Of a father and son who both won military distinction and a father and son …

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
同肩顯爵者孰勝之數人皆中州之彥
諸士素所企慕者其所願學者誰歟詳
著于篇以觀尚友之志
問黃河之經中州自神禹以到于今遷變
不知幾次疏治不知幾人茲方講求今
日之急往事不暇論矣竊有疑焉古今
一河也古之治河者率挽之而從北今
之治河者率導之而從南何古今之懸
絕歟一河也近有塞之而慮其有
===
損於　又有渡之而欲其有利於漕
者何彼此之背馳歟先代善論河者無
如漢賈讓不知讓策可施於今歟
□代善理漕者無如陳恭襄不知厥蹟可比
於古歟金龍口今運道之要害也或者
慮其障塞莫禦欲於淮泗下流分數河
以泄上流之勢其策可推行歟汴梁城
古中州之都會也或者慮其形勢卑下
欲擇上地遷省城以避潰決之虞其事
punctuated:
同肩顯爵者孰勝？之數人皆中州之彥，諸士素所企慕者，其所願學者誰歟？詳著于篇，以觀尚友之志。

問：黃河之經中州，自神禹以到于今，遷變不知幾次，疏治不知幾人。茲方講求今日之急，往事不暇論矣。竊有疑焉：古今一河也，古之治河者率挽之而從北，今之治河者率導之而從南，何古今之懸絕歟？一河也，近有塞之而慮其有損於　，又有渡之而欲其有利於漕者，何彼此之背馳歟？先代善論河者，無如漢賈讓，不知讓策可施於今歟？□代善理漕者，無如陳恭襄，不知厥蹟可比於古歟？金龍口，今運道之要害也。或者慮其障塞莫禦，欲於淮泗下流分數河，以泄上流之勢，其策可推行歟？汴梁城，古中州之都會也。或者慮其形勢卑下，欲擇上地遷省城，以避潰決之虞，其事
translation_en:
…and those who both held illustrious noble rank—which were superior? These men [?] were all outstanding figures of Zhongzhou whom you candidates have long admired. Whom would you wish to emulate? Set this out fully in your essays, so that we may see your aspirations to take worthy men of the past as your friends.

Question: From the time of the divine Yu down to the present, the Yellow River flowing through Zhongzhou has changed course countless times, and countless men have dredged and regulated it. We are now investigating the urgent needs of the present and have no leisure to discuss past affairs. Yet there are matters about which I have doubts. It is the same river, ancient and modern: those who regulated it in antiquity generally drew it northward, while those who regulate it today generally guide it southward. Why is there so great a difference between ancient and modern practice? Again, it is the same river: recently some have blocked it, yet feared that this would harm [the object is missing]; others have sought to channel it [?] so that it would benefit grain transport. Why do these approaches run counter to one another? Among those of earlier dynasties who discussed the river well, none equaled Jia Rang of the Han. Could Rang’s proposals be applied today? Among those of the □ dynasty who skillfully managed grain transport, none equaled Chen Gongxiang. Could his achievements compare with those of antiquity? Jinlongkou is now a critical point on the transport route. Some fear that its blockage may become impossible to check and wish to create several channels in the lower reaches of the Huai and Si rivers to relieve the force of the waters upstream. Could this proposal be put into practice? The city of Bianliang has long been the principal urban center of Zhongzhou. Some, concerned that its terrain is low-lying, wish to select higher ground and relocate the provincial capital to avert the danger of breached embankments and flooding. This undertaking…

title: 正德二年河南鄉試錄
text:
可遂舉歟二策一有不可將使運道會
通朝東海於無極汴藩壯固拱北辰於
無涯其策將安出歟或不得已二議亦
可采歟今
聖人龍興將畫河圖以
虜諸士生長是邦必有能助我者
punctuated: 可遂舉歟？二策一有不可，將使運道會通，朝東海於無極；汴藩壯固，拱北辰於無涯，其策將安出歟？或不得已，二議亦可采歟？今聖人龍興，將畫河圖以虜，諸士生長是邦，必有能助我者。
translation_en: …can this undertaking actually be carried out? If either of these two plans proves impracticable, what strategy could ensure that the grain-transport waterways remain interconnected and flow toward the Eastern Sea forever, and that Bian, the provincial seat, remains strong and secure, forever paying homage to the Northern Pole Star? Or, if no other course is possible, might these two proposals nevertheless be adopted? Now that the sage emperor has risen like a dragon, he intends to draw up a plan for the river [以虜, “in order to capture,” is doubtful here: ?]. You gentlemen were born and raised in this region; surely some among you can assist me.
